questions.question: A ______ is a computer programme which can self-replicate and propagate over the network with or without human intervention and has malicious intent.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Worm.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• A **worm**__ is a computer programme that can **self-replicate and propagate over the network with or without human intervention and has malicious intent.**
 
• Its purpose is to secretly **duplicate itself into other computers.**
 
• Unlike a computer virus, which "infects" other programmes in order to spread to new ones, worms are often self-contained programmes that **do not require a "host."**
 
• Worms typically **do not require human intervention** to spread across networks.
 
• **Robert Morris**, a computer science student at Cornell University, unleashed the first worm into the Internet from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology on November 2, 1988.
 
• Viruses and worms are a type of **malicious software.**
 
• Worms frequently take advantage of network configuration mistakes or security flaws in the operating system (OS) or applications.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• A** kernel** is computer software that runs at the core of the operating system and has complete control over all of the system's components.
 
• A **Trojan Horse **Virus is a sort of malware that disguises itself as a genuine programme and downloads into a computer.
 
• A computer **virus** is designed to spread from host to host and duplicate itself.

questions.question: A government budget is an annual financial statement which outlines estimated government expenditures and expected government receipts or revenues for the forthcoming fiscal year. Depending on the feasibility of these estimates which of the following is **NOT** the budget type?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Economy budget**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• Among the options, only an **Economy budget**__ is **NOT** a budget type.
 
• A government budget is an annual financial statement that outlines estimated government expenditures and expected government receipts or revenues for the forthcoming fiscal year.
 
• In India, it is a constitutional requirement (**Article 112**) that the government give a statement of estimated income and expenditures to Parliament for each financial year that runs from April 1 to March 31.
 
• This 'Annual Financial Statement' is the government's primary budget document.
 
• Budgets are grouped into three categories based on these estimates:
 
 
• Balanced budget.
 
• Surplus budget.
 
• Deficit budget.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A government budget is said to be a **balanced budget** if the estimated government expenditures in a given fiscal year are equal to the expected government receipts.

 
 
• A balanced budget ensures economic stability if implemented successfully.
 
• A balanced budget is Inapplicable in less developed countries as it limits the scope of economic growth.
 
 
 
• A government budget is said to be a** surplus budget **if the expected government revenues exceed the estimated government expenditure in a particular financial year.
 
 
• A country's financial wealth is indicated by a surplus budget.
 
 
 
• If the estimated government expenditure exceeds the expected government revenue in a given fiscal year, the budget is considered to be a **deficit budget.**
 
 
• A deficit budget is best suited for developing economies, such as India

questions.question: When did the peasant movement in Bardoli begin?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1928.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• In India, the **Bardoli movement** was a tax-free movement.
 
• In the year **1928**__, the Bardoli Satyagraha took place.
 
• This movement was known as one of the biggest incidents of the Civil Disobedience movement, which was a part of India's war for independence.
 
• **Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel **eventually headed the movement, and its success helped pave the way for Patel to become one of the most prominent leaders of the independence struggle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

 
• Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel initially wrote to the** Governor of Bombay**, requesting that the taxes be reduced during the year during which the tragedies were occurring.
 
• The Governor, on the other hand, ignored the letter and responded by announcing the collection.
 
• The Bombay Presidency ignored the plight of the farmers and increased tax **rates by 22%.**
 
• Patel then informed all of the farmers in the Bardoli taluka to **refuse to pay their taxes.**
 
• The government had commissioned the **Maxwell-Broomfield Commission** to investigate the situation.
 
• Following a thorough investigation, the tax increase was determined to be only **6.03%.**
 
• Gandhiji also supported the movement through his writings in the periodical '**Young India**.'

questions.question: ICAR is an autonomous body responsible for coordinating agriculture and research in India. What is the full form of ICAR?

options.text: Indian Centre of Agriculture and Research

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian Council of Agricultural Research.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indian Council of Agricultural Research**__ is the **full form of ICAR.**
 
• ICAR is an autonomous body responsible for coordinating agriculture and research in India. 
 
• It was established under the Department of **Agricultural Research and Education (DARE).**
 
• ICAR was formerly known as the** Imperial Council of Agricultural Research **
 
• In response to the Royal Commission on Agriculture's recommendations, it was founded on **July 16, 1929**, as a registered society under the Societies Registration Act, 1860.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

 
• **New Delhi **is the headquarters of the** ICAR.**
 
• The Council is the country's top organization for coordinating, supervising, and managing agricultural research and education, encompassing horticulture, fisheries, and animal sciences.
 
• ICAR is one of the **world's largest national agricultural systems**, with 111 ICAR institutes and 71 agricultural universities distributed around the country.

questions.question: Where did Union Minister of Earth Sciences Dr. Harsh Vardhan virtually inaugurate India’s highest Meteorological Centre?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Leh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Union Minister of Earth Sciences Dr. Harsh Vardhan** virtually inaugurates India’s highest Meteorological Centre in **Leh, Ladak.**__
 
• It is located at **3,500 metres above sea level in Leh.**
 
• The Leh centre is the second Meteorological Centre in the Himalayas, after** Itanagar in Arunachal Pradesh.**
 
• It would give localised weather predictions and early warnings for the **Union Territory's Leh and Kargil districts**, as well as various tourist destinations.
 
• All stakeholders will receive regular updates from the new meteorological centre, which will provide weather forecasts for short (3 days), medium (12 days), and long (1 month) periods.
 
• The **India Meteorological Department (IMD)** intends to set up ten Automatic Weather Stations (AWS) in key sites such as **Drass, Kargil, Pangong Tso, Zanskar Valley, and Nubra Valley.**
 
• Currently, India has **28 meteorological centres** located throughout the country.
 
• The **India Meteorological Department (IMD)**, the country's primary agency for meteorological observations and forecasting, relies on these centres to deliver accurate and timely weather-related information.

questions.question: _______ is a set of norms and guidelines to be followed by the political parties and contesting candidates during election time.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Code of Conduct.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Code of Conduct**__ is a set of norms and guidelines to be **followed by the political parties and contesting candidates during election time.**
 
• The **Election Commission** of India issues a set of guidelines for candidates and political parties to follow during elections.
 
• Speeches, polling booths, polling day conduct, election manifestos, processions, and general conduct are all covered under the criteria.
 
• It comes into effect as soon as the election schedule is announced by the Election Commission of India.
 
• Respective parties are required to notify the local police department in advance of scheduled meetings, providing accurate information on the location and time, in order to maintain law and order and control traffic in the area.
 
• During the election process, government bodies are barred from participating in any **recruitment procedure.**
 
• **Kerala** was the first state in India to use the model code of conduct in its elections in 1960.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• According to the **Model Code of Conduct **no party or candidate can:

 
 
• **Use any place of religion for electoral propaganda.**
 
• **For elections, use government vehicles, planes, and personnel.**
 
• **Ministers are not allowed to lay foundation stones for any projects, make major policy choices, or make commitments to provide public services until elections are announced.**

questions.question: Which of the following is **not **a good conductor of electricity?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Diamond.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Among the options, only diamond is NOT a good conductor of electricity**__.
 
• **Diamond** is a naturally-occurring solid.
 __
 
• It is a mineral composed of **pure carbon.**
 
• Diamond is the smallest mass element capable of forming a stable covalently bonded crystal lattice with a highly symmetric and tightly bound structure.
 
• Diamond does not conduct electricity, is a **good electrical insulator.**
 
 
• Pure diamond is unable to conduct electricity because it lacks any delocalized free electrons in the carbon atom's outer shell.
 
 
 
• Diamond is a good **conductor of heat **due to its strong covalent bonding and low phonon scattering.
 
• All of the carbon atoms in the diamond lattice are **sp³ hybridized.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Graphite** is a crystalline form of carbon with its atoms arranged in a hexagonal structure.

 
 
• Graphite is a good conductor of electricity.
 
 
 
• **Gold** is a chemical element with the **atomic number 79**.
 
 
• Gold is a good conductor of both electricity and heat.
 
 
 
• **Soils** are electric current conductors.

questions.question: _______ are built up by the liquid and solid rock erupting from the earth’s interior.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Volcanoes**__.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **A volcano is a conical hill or mountain built around a vent that connects to reservoirs of molten rock beneath the Earth's surface**__.

 __
 
• Volcanoes are formed from liquid and solid rock emanating from the interior of the Earth.
 
• A hole or vent from which molten rock and associated gases escape is also called a volcano.
 
• Volcanoes are mountains, but they are not like other mountains, because they do not result from folding and crumpling, or uplift and erosion.
 
• Volcanoes are formed by the accumulation of explosive materials such as lava and bombs.
 
• Volcanoes occur most often on Earth when tectonic plates are separating or convergent, and most of them are found underwater.
 
• Basalt, a form of lava that is typically liquid when erupted, forms most volcanoes.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fault-block mountains **are formed by the movement of large crustal blocks, which are formed when stressing forces pull the crust apart.
 
• **Circum-erosional or relict or residual mountains** (Aravallis in India, Urals in Russia) are remnants of older fold mountains that have resulted from denudation. Residual mountains may also develop from plateaus that have been divided by rivers into hills and valleys.
 
• A **plateau **is a flat, elevated landform that rises sharply from the surrounding area on at least one side. Plateaus occur on every continent and occupy one-third of the Earth's landmass. They are one of the four major landforms along with mountains, plains and hills.

questions.question: Amino acids are often referred to as the building blocks of _______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**proteins.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Amino acids** are chemical molecules with an amino group and an acidic group on the same carbon atom.
 
• **Amino acids are often referred to as the building blocks of proteins**__.
 __
 
• They are organic compounds that combine to form proteins.
 
• They also help in **hormone and neurotransmitter synthesis.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **Proteins**__ are polypeptides.

 __
 
• Proteins are linear chains of amino acids linked by **peptide bonds.**
 
• Proteins are known as **building blocks of life.**
 
• Proteins are made up of Carbon, Hydrogen, Oxygen, and Nitrogen.
 
• Proteins make up around 60% of the dry weight of cells and are the most prevalent molecules in the body.
 
• Protein is the nutrient known as 'bodybuilders'.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Triglyceride is the simple unit of **Fat.**
 
• Fats and **carbohydrates** are the energy sources of the body.
 
• Sucrose is the most commonly used **sugar** form.

questions.question: A User Interface is the part of _______ that allows the user to enter and receive information.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **operating system.**

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Computer software includes both system and application software, and it's the component that enables user interaction through a user interface**__.

 __
 
• The user interface (UI) is a software feature that allows users to interact with the computer, enter commands, and receive feedback.
 
• The UI can be graphical (GUI) or text-based (CLI), and is present in operating systems, apps, and other programs.
 
• Therefore, UI is not exclusive to the operating system but spans across all types of software.
 
• Examples of software with UI include:
 
 
• Operating systems like Windows, Linux, macOS.
 
• Applications like Microsoft Word, Google Chrome, VLC Media Player.
 
• Mobile apps and development tools.
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Operating System** is a type of system software that manages hardware and provides core UI elements like taskbars, file explorers, etc.
 
• **Computer Network** refers to interconnected systems that share resources but are not the source of UI themselves.
 
• **Hardware** refers to the physical components like keyboard, monitor, CPU – which are used by UI but do not provide it themselves.

questions.question: The world’s oldest first-class cricketer and World War II veteran, Alan Burgess passed away in January 2021. He represented which of the following countries?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**New Zealand.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

__
 
• **Alan Burgess was a former New Zealand cricketer**__.

 __
 
• He played first-class cricket for Canterbury from 1940 to 1952.
 
• During **World War II,** he served as a tank driver.
 
• He joined the New Zealand Army in 1941.
 
• In 1944, he took part in the** Battle of Monte Cassino.**
 
• He toured England with the New Zealand Services team as a batsman after the war in Europe finished.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• Alan Burgess was the **world's oldest living first-class cricketer**.

 
 
• He passed away in **January 2021.**
 
• When Tom Pritchard died in August 2017, Alan Burgess became** New Zealand's oldest living first-class cricketer.**
 
• Burgess became the oldest living first-class cricketer on June 13, 2020, when **Vasant Raiji died.**
 
 
 
• Following Burgess' death, **Raghunath Chandorkar** of India became the world's oldest living first-class cricketer, while** Iain Gallaway** of New Zealand became the world's oldest living first-class cricketer.

questions.question: Which type of dam is a temporary dam constructed to exclude water from the specific area?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Coffer**__.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **A cofferdam is a temporary dam constructed to exclude water from a specific area**__.

 __
 
• It is designed to allow for the construction of a permanent structure in arid environments, along with damming, diversion, or dewatering.
 
• A cofferdam is constructed of a waterproof fence by depositing sheets into a bed, which is usually steel in modern works.
 
• The walls of a cofferdam must be solid and well-bonded, to withstand the shock of hitting a heavy dredging bucket; When water is pulled out of the cofferdam, they must also be able to bear horizontal forces from the surrounding body of water.
 
• Water should not be able to enter the construction site because of the dam walls.
 
• As a result, the height of the wall must exceed the excessive water level, and it must also be waterproof.
 
• Dams are preferred in large construction sites and places with sufficient depth of dry soil bed.
 
• Permanent dams, oil platforms, bridge piers, and other structures standing in or above water are regularly built or repaired along cofferdams.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• An **impounding reservoir** is a basin built in the valley of a stream or river to contain stream flow so that the stored water can be used when supply is in short supply.
 
• A **detention dam** is a structure designed to capture surface runoff and stream water flow in order to control the flow of water in areas below the dam.
 
• **Debris dams** are a form of detention dam that collects material to keep it from flowing into locations where a substantial deposit of debris could be harmful.
